verification_steps: Test: with knot A locally leased and remote events for A and B, pull applies B and quarantines A; after the lease terminates, the next pull applies A's events and the final state matches an unfiltered sync.
Test: a knot quarantined across three successive pulls with interleaved events replays every event exactly once, in order.
Test: an active lease owned by another machine does not quarantine its knot locally.
Test: quarantine rows persist across a reopened connection.
Manual: run two agents holding leases concurrently and confirm kno sync completes and reports the held-back knots.
make sanity passes (fmt, lint, tests, coverage >= .ci/coverage-threshold.txt).
